a: Alexander Maclaren (1826–1910) yali mubuulizi Omusukoti ow'Ababatisiti eyaweereza mu Union Chapel, e Manchester, okumala emyaka amakumi ana mu etaano — "omulangira w'ababuulizi abannyonnyozi b'Ebyawandiikibwa," eyasomanga buli lunaku, obulamu bwe bwonna, Ebyawandiikibwa mu Luyonaani ne mu Lwebbulaniya, era okusoma okwo kwe kwaliisa emikuutu egyakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu "Expositions of Holy Scripture." Obulamu bwe tebwali bwa bubonero na byamagero, wabula obw'obwesigwa obunywevu era obutakutuka ennyo, obuyinza okwangu obutafiibwako.

Yazaalibwa e Glasgow nga 11 Febwali 1826, mutabani w'omusuubuzi eyali era omubuulizi ow'Ababatisiti atali musumba mutongole, bw'atyo n'akula ng'awulira Ebyawandiikibwa nga binnyonnyolwa awaka. Yasomera mu Glasgow University, oluvannyuma amaka bwe gaasengukira e London, n'atendekebwa olw'obuweereza mu Stepney College okuva mu 1842, omukugu mu Lwebbulaniya Benjamin Davies gye yamunywereza ennyo mu Luyonaani ne mu Lwebbulaniya nga oluvannyuma teyaddamu kuleka lunaku kuyitawo nga tabisomye. Awo we yakolerwa ng'omunnyonnyozi w'Ebyawandiikibwa — omuntu eyandimaze ekitundu ky'ekyasa ng'aggya emikuutu mu bigambo byennyini eby'Ebyawandiikibwa.

Mu Portland Chapel e Southampton, gye yatandika okuweereza mu Jjuuni 1846, ng'ayitiddwa ng'omusigire okumala emyezi nga esatu mu kibiina ekitono eky'abantu amakumi abiri. Emyezi esatu ne gifuuka emyaka kkumi n'ebiri. Kwali kuyiga kuzibu era okutaalina kitiibwa, naye kwamuyigiriza obukugu obwandimufudde omututumufu: engeri y'okutwala ekyawandiikibwa ekimu n'akibikkula okutuusa ekibiina eky'abantu aba bulijjo lwe kirabamu enjiri yonna ng'eyimiriddemu.

q: Obuweereza bwe mu Union Chapel, e Manchester bwali butya?
a: Mu 1858 yayitibwa mu Union Chapel, e Manchester, era n'abeera eyo obulamu bwe bwonna obw'emirimu — okuva mu 1858 okutuuka mu 1903, emyaka amakumi ana mu etaano, ng'abuulira kumpi abantu be bamu, mu kibuga kye kimu, okuva mu kitabo kye kimu. Buno bwe bumu ku buweereza obw'ebbanga eddene obusinga okwewuunyisa mu kyasa ekyo, era mwe mwava erinnya eryamugoberera okuva olwo: omulangira w'ababuulizi abannyonnyozi b'Ebyawandiikibwa. Ebibinja by'abantu byavanga mu kibuga kyonna okujja okumuwulira, n'abaweereza abato ne bajja okuyiga, naye teyanoonya ttutumu.

q: Yakuuma nkola ki mu kusoma kwe?
a: Amaanyi ge ku kituuti gaali bibala by'enkola etaggwaamu maanyi. Buli nkya yasomanga essuula emu ey'Endagaano Enkadde mu Lwebbulaniya n'essuula emu ey'Endagaano Empya mu Luyonaani — si ng'omuyivu awagala ebikozesebwa bye, wabula ng'omusinza. Yayingiranga mu kisenge kye eky'okusomeramu ku ssaawa ssatu ez'enkya era, nga bwe kyayogerwanga, yayambalanga engatto enzito ez'okukoleramu ebweru okwejjukiza nti kye yali agenda okukola mulimu gwa maanyi. Ekisenge kye kyali kya kusomeramu, so si kya kuwummuliramu; tewaali ssimu, era okutaataaganyizibwa tekwayanirizibwanga.

q: Okusaba kwe n'okusoma kwe byakwatagana bitya?
a: Tebyali bintu bibiri wabula kimu. Ekitundu ky'essaawa buli lunaku mu Byawandiikibwa eby'Olwebbulaniya n'Oluyonaani kyennyini kye kyali okusinza kwe — Ekigambo ekyakkirizibwanga ng'afukamidde buli nkya, bw'atyo bwe yayimiriranga okukibuulira, yali ateeka bweteese ku balala ekyo kye yali amaze okufuna mu kwegatta ne Katonda. Yalowooza nti okubudaabudibwa n'obulungi bw'omulimu gw'omubuulizi byeyongera oba bikendeera okusinziira ddala ku buziba bw'okwegatta kwe ne Katonda buli lunaku; okubala ebibala kwe okw'ebbanga eddene bwe bwali obujulizi obulabika obw'obulamu obukusike.

q: Yategekanga atya emikuutu gye era n'agibuulira atya?
a: Yagaana okutegeka nga wakyabulayo wiiki nnyingi: "Nnina okubuwa nga bukyaaka," bwe yagamba — obubaka bwalina okuva nga bubuguma mu muliro gw'enkya eyo, so si kubugumya okuva mu bbaluwa ennyogovu ez'ewiiki ewedde. Yabuuliranga nga talina kiwandiiko, empisa eyava ku kabenje akatono: ebbaluwa ze yali ateeseeko mu Bayibuli ye ne zifuumuulibwa empewo mu kusinza, n'amalirira obutaddayo kwolekera bantu be nga waliwo akapapula wakati waabwe. Okumala ekitundu ky'ekyasa yawandiikanga sentensi ze ntono ez'okusooka zokka n'abuulira ebisigadde okuva ku lupapula lumu olwaliko emitwe emikalu gyokka.

Gyamalanga eddakiika nga amakumi ana n'ebigambo nga enkumi nnya, nga ginywerera ku kyawandiikibwa era kumpi buli kiseera nga gigabanyizibwamu emitwe esatu egitegeerekeka — ekyali kya bulijjo ennyo omuvumirizi ow'omukwano n'agamba nti yagabulanga omugaati ogw'obulamu n'ewuuma ey'amannyo asatu. Naye enteekateeka tebeeranga kkomera; yali ngeri ya kutwala kibiina, ensonga ku nsonga, mu mutima gw'ekitundu ky'Ebyawandiikibwa okutuusa lwe bakirabira ddala kyonna. Yabuuliranga okumatiza, so si kwewaana, ng'alowooza nti omulimu ogw'olubereberye kwe kwegyawo, waleme kubaawo kintu kiyimirira wakati w'abamuwuliriza ne Kristo ow'ekyawandiikibwa.

Nti omutima gw'omuntu gwakolebwa olwa Katonda era tegufuna kuwummula okutuusa lwe guwummulira mu Ye. Yalina ekirabo ky'okwogera sentensi ezijjukirwa ezitava mu birowoozo: "Ebirabo by'ensi eno bitama era tebikkusa; Katonda akkusa era tatama." Eddiini ye teyali ya kweraliikirira — okuwummula kwe yasemba tekwali mpeera ya kufuba nnyo, wabula emirembe egy'obutonde egy'omwoyo ogufunye amaka gaagwo: "Tuba tuwummudde bwe tuba ne Katonda, era okumwegomba kwe kukakasa okufuna ekirungi ekituukiridde era ekimala byonna."

Emyaka amakumi ana mu etaano egy'emikuutu gyakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu mulimu abasomi abasinga gwe bamumanyiramu leero, "Expositions of Holy Scripture," ennyinnyonnyola egenda mu maaso ey'ekitabo kyonna ekya Baibuli eyaggibwa butereevu ku kituuti, era terekeddwangako kukozesebwa — ng'eyigiriza emirembe n'emirembe egy'ababuulizi engeri y'okuzuula omukuutu ogwakwekebwa dda mu kyawandiikibwa. Yaleka obusumba obw'emirimu mu 1903, emyaka amakumi ana mu etaano ddala okuva ku lunaku lwe yabutandika, era n'afiira mu Edinburgh nga 5 Mayi 1910. Obulamu bwe bwe bujulizi obusirise obw'okubuulira kwe yennyini: nti omuntu eyeekuumira okumpi n'ensulo tagenda kukalira.
